craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Gore-decked teaches pure (chuddham print per UNC); red kept raw. Rejected: (a) normalizing print → killed by UNC. Read aloud: BONE in-HAND … SO-teach-es THE-lord.

lines: Bone in hand, skulls garlanded, ash-smeared, man-blood-red —
world by Brahma-fullness pure — so teaches the Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: asthikaramuṇḍamālābhasmābharaṇo nṛraktaruciḥ viśvaṃ brahmamayatvāc chuddham itīśaḥ samādiśasi

reads_against.argmap: How teach pure through gore? → Gore-decked teaches pure by Brahma-fullness.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
reads_against.c1_rasa: pāna-vīra of drunk world-saps; vīra of held lotuses; vīra of mirrored seed; vīra of letter-turned world; raudra-vīra of gore-taught pure; raudra of brow-eye burning; vīra of aimed inward; adbhuta of bare-speaking sky; adbhuta of dark-shown destroyer; vīra-śānta of parted-freed
